Yellow captions appear at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to a female character with short black hair wearing a navy blue buttoned coat. She gestures actively with both hands as she speaks. The lighting is soft and warm, typical of a studio. She maintains consistent eye contact towards an off-screen interviewer. (3) A digital graphic replaces the live-action footage. It features a cartoon woman on a blue grid background with the text '18歲的美照'. This visual serves to illustrate the concept of using outdated, flattering photos in rental listings. An overlaying cartoon depicts a boy trying to read while being disturbed by red noise symbols and the text '隔音效果 非常不好'. (6) A cartoon animation shows a woman in a green dress holding a blue bowl to catch water dripping from a ceiling, accompanied by the text '會漏水'. The video concludes with a black screen displaying the main title and a 'click here' call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about common deceptive practices on rental websites in Taiwan. It specifically warns against outdated 'beauty shots' of apartments and misleading terminology such as 'large terraces' which frequently mask illegal rooftop additions with poor soundproofing and leakage issues.
